_comment: SPOILER İÇERİR. Kural tablosu. Metinler {tr, en}. 'where' = kesim noktasının konumla anlatımı (varsayılan görünüm), 'label' = adıyla (yalnız gizli bölümde, nokta geçildikten sonra). 'whereExact' = aynı cümle yer/boss adlarıyla (yalnız 'tam adlar' ayarı açıkken ve 'exactWhen' koşulu doğruyken, yani oyuncu o bölgeye ulaştıysa; yoksa 'where'). guess=true doğrulanmamış tahmin. Görev adları data/names.json + Türkçe yamadan gelir. warnNamed (yalnız type=info): adlı metin, yalnız gizli bölümde. activeWhen: uyarı varsayılan görünümde ne zaman dursun (type=info) / ne zaman başlasın (kaçırılabilir). doneWhen type=info için de geçerli: doğruysa uyarı varsayılan görünümden çıkar. itemSeen: data/items.json kodları. levelVisited/currentLevel birden çok bölgeyi kapsayabilir (Zhengdaodaying = Ferman Ordugâhı + Lu Köyü); bölge için mapUnlocked/bellPrefix kullan. source: {ids (sources anahtarları), checked}. Rule syntax / koşul dili: README.md "Rule syntax", README.tr.md "Kural tablosu". schemaVersion: dosya biçimi (araç uyuşmazsa reddeder). rulesVersion: kural içeriğinin sürümü (her düzeltmede artır, başlıkta görünür). Exe'nin yanına konan rules.json gömülü olanın yerine geçer. unverified=true: tek kaynak / tartışmalı; varsayılan görünümde uyarı üretmez, yalnız gizli bölümde "doğrulanmamış" notuyla görünür. claim: kurala dönüşmeyen iddia (yalnız kayıt). regions: oyun bölgeleri (hikâye sırası, harita kodları, çan önekleri); her cutoff ve missable bir region taşır (işin yapıldığı bölge; dizi ise ilki birincil), uyarılar buna göre gruplanır (lib/report.js build → groups).

sources._comment: Kural kaynakları. url=null: adres doğrulanamadı (eklenmeli). Kurallardaki source.checked: 'unverified' = kural-kaynak eşleşmesi devir notundaki genel listeden, sayfada kontrol edilmedi; 'search-snippet' = arama sonucunun özetinde bu kuralın o kaynakta geçtiği görüldü, sayfa açılmadı. 'page' = kaynak sayfası açılıp (özet aracıyla) kuralın orada geçtiği görüldü.

If part 1 was skipped, the Pangzhen hand-in marker may look empty (single report, unverified). Region: crimson-forest, where the part-1 hand-in (the Outpost) happens; the quest itself starts in the Weeping Creek Valley.

Region: pangzhen first (the quest is in the journal before any lake map is seen and the gate is there), meigu-lake as the likely place of its steps (CN guide); unsure. Steps (PowerUp Gaming / KeenGamer): 6 Firefly's Memory Flowers in the Village of Lu → Dusk the Puppeteer → four Acolyte masks (Yanru fire, Lei Ting lightning, Guhe poison, Hansui ice in Crimson Manor) → two Crystal Puppet Eyes (Yin: hanging puppet, Mountain of Imprisonment; Yang: Hansui drop) → Four Guardians' Mirror (Bell_LYZ_011, frozen NW shore of Meigu Lake, map MeiGuHu) → Discordance realm / Phantom Illusionist Ruins (level PBZ_Huanshuyiji2_WP, LYZ bells) → Blizzard Blademaster at Whiteshadow's Fall (Bell_LYZ_014) → red statue, insert both eyes → Heart of the Lake ritual → Inanis. Save 2026-11-08: S1/S2/S4 Completed, S3 + branch 3 Activating while inside the realm (last bell Bell_LYZ_013).

hintStarted.tr: Sıra: Lu Köyü'nde Ateşböceği anı çiçekleri (6) → Alacakaranlık (Kukla Ustası) → dört Mürit maskesi (ateş, yıldırım, zehir; buz olan Kızıl Malikâne'de Hansui) → iki Kristal Kukla Gözü (Yin: Hapis Dağı'ndaki asılı kukla; Yang: Hansui) → Meigu Gölü'nün kuzeybatı donmuş kıyısındaki Dört Muhafızın Aynası → Uyumsuzluk alemi → Beyazgölge'nin Düşüşü'nde Tipi Kılıç Ustası → kırmızı heykele iki gözü tak → Gölün Kalbi'nde ayini durdur. Hepsi Mirage Estate köprüsünden önce.
hintStarted.en: Order: Firefly's Memory Flowers (6) in the Village of Lu → Dusk the Puppeteer → four Acolyte masks (fire, lightning, poison; the ice one is Hansui in Crimson Manor) → two Crystal Puppet Eyes (Yin: hanging puppet in Mountain of Imprisonment; Yang: Hansui) → Four Guardians' Mirror on the frozen NW shore of Meigu Lake → Discordance realm → Blizzard Blademaster at Whiteshadow's Fall → put both eyes in the red statue → stop the ritual at the Heart of the Lake. All before the Mirage Estate bridge.

warn.tr: Gölün donmuş kıyısındaki büyük aynaya girmeden önce ağır baltanı, onarılmış pipayı ve iki kristal gözü yanına al; içeride sondaki dövüşe gitmeden her bölümü bitir.
warn.en: Before entering the big mirror on the frozen lake shore bring the heavy axe, the repaired pipa and both crystal eyes; inside, clear every section before the final fight.

warnNamed.tr: Dört Muhafızın Aynası / Uyumsuzluk alemi (Hayalet İllüzyonist Harabeleri): girmeden Dread Axe, onarılmış Hayali Pipa ve iki Kristal Kukla Gözü yanında olsun. İçeride: 4. Lóng Sütunu (zincirleri balta kırar, Altın Maskeli), pipayla açılan sis duvarının ardında Karataş parçası, iki Sha-Chi Kehribarı parçası, Beyazgölge görevi için Tipi Kılıç Ustası'nın 6 anı çiçeği, Beyazgölge'yi tavlamak için Çocuğun Yıpranmış Giysisi'nin 4 parçası (ayakkabılar: tabutlu yamaçtan aşağı kayarak; başlık: balıkçı köyünde gemi çatısı; pantolon: sisli yerleşimin çıkışındaki büyük çadır; gömlek: 4. çandan sonra yüzen enkazlar, köprüden önce sağdaki ahşap merdiven); en son Yasak Patika çanından tekne yoluyla Beyazgölge'nin Düşüşü'nde Tipi Kılıç Ustası (Whiteshadow silahı), sonra kırmızı heykel. Dövüşten ve göl görevinden sonra da dönülebilir: kırık ayna "İlk Çana / Önceki Çana Hızlı Seyahat Yap" seçenekleriyle alemin içine ışınlar.
warnNamed.en: Four Guardians' Mirror / Discordance realm (Phantom Illusionist Ruins): bring the Dread Axe, the repaired Illusory Pipa and both Crystal Puppet Eyes before entering. Inside: 4th Lóng Pillar (axe breaks the chains, Gold-Masked One), a Blackstone fragment behind the mist wall the pipa clears, two Sha-Chi Amber fragments, the Blizzard Blademaster's 6 memory flowers for the Whiteshadow tale, the 4 pieces of the Boy's Worn Outfit that tempers Whiteshadow (shoes: slide down the coffin cliffside; cap: ship roof in the fishing village; trousers: big tent at the exit of the foggy settlement; shirt: floating wrecks after the 4th bell, wooden stairs on the right before the bridge); last, from the Forbidden Path bell take the boat path to Whiteshadow's Fall for the Blizzard Blademaster (Whiteshadow weapon), then the red statue. The realm stays open after the fight and the lake quest: the shattered mirror offers "fast travel to the first bell / previous bell" of the realm.

missables.note: KeenGamer acolytes/Discordance guide + PowerUp Gaming. Realm = level PBZ_Huanshuyiji2_WP with LYZ bells on map MeiGuHu (Bell_LYZ_010 Frozen Lake Dock, 011 Four Guardians' Mirror, 013 Forbidden Path, 014 Whiteshadow's Fall) and BrokenBell_HSSYJ_01..07 (group HuanShuShi). warn.tr: Bu kamptaki kule çatısında bir kadın kılıç ustasıyla dövüş başlarsa onu yenme; canı bitmeden arena kenarındaki zincirle çatıdan ayrıl. Yenersen bir kolye, bir anı çiçeği ve hikâyesinin devamı kaçar; sağ kalırsa sonraki bir boss dövüşünde tekrar çıkar.
warn.en: If a fight with a swordswoman starts on a tower roof in this camp, do not defeat her; leave the roof by the chain at the arena edge before her health runs out. Beating her loses a pendant, a memory flower and the rest of her story; alive, she returns in a later boss fight.

warnNamed.tr: Ferman Ordugâhı, Güvercinlik kulesi çatısı: Red'i (Kızıl, Gizemli Kılıç Ustası) yenme; canı bitmeden kenardaki zincirle çatıdan ayrıl. Yenersen Twin Fish Pendant, Tower Rear Exit'teki anı çiçeği ve Karanlık Tarikatın Kızı'nın devamı kaçar; sağ kalırsa Üç Kuleler'de Baş Mürit'in 2. fazında geri gelir (zorlaşır ama tüm ödüllerin tek yolu).
warnNamed.en: Mandate Encampment, Dovecote tower roof: don't defeat Red, the Mysterious Swordswoman; leave the roof by the chain at the edge before her health runs out. Beating her loses the Twin Fish Pendant, the memory flower at Tower Rear Exit and the rest of Daughter of the Dark Sect; alive, she returns in phase 2 of the Chief Disciple fight at the Three Towers (harder, but the only way to all rewards).

The name "Daughter of the Dark Sect" appears in no source: unverified. Region: the level PBZ_Zhengdaodaying_WP also holds the Village of Lu, so levelVisited/currentLevel are not used; reached = an encampment bell (Bell_YXZR_*, Bell_ZDDY_*) other than Bell_YXZR_018 (outer gate, lit on the way to Lu). Temporary approach: bellPrefix YXZR (except Bell_YXZR_018) / ZDDY; switch to mapUnlocked with the real map code once the Mandate Encampment is reached (the code is in no save yet). activeWhen: the last bell used is an encampment bell. Update 2026-11-06: the tale is MoJiaoZhiNv (QuestRumor_015 "KARANLIK TARİKATIN KIZI" = Daughter of the Dark Sect), seen in a save when the player met Red, so the name is verified; the warning stops once that tale is done. Update 2026-11-07: Game8 read in full: "Do not defeat Red during your first encounter, or you will miss the Twin Fish Pendant"; "use the nearby chain to exit the arena"; "Leaving her alive forces her to appear alongside the Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars later" (harder, "the only way to secure all possible rewards"). Matches the Steam thread (defeat = item + flower lost). One Steam player claims fleeing cost map 100% (likely the boss entry until she returns); guides still recommend sparing. guess removed. Real-save check 2026-11-07 00:11: Red is BP_Monster_EMei_Sword_Top (AttemptCount 1, no KillCount after leaving by the chain); MoJiaoZhiNv branch S1 Activating → branch "1" Activating at 00:09:06, item R_03026 four seconds later. doneWhen = branch 1 reached (Activating or Completed) or tale done; activeWhen also stops once the boss has a kill.

Region: mount-soulrend = the final cutoff; the quest's own steps span earlier areas (not mapped). Five Lóng Pillar trials (PowerUp Gaming): Weeping Creek Valley (Rusted Loong Key, east caves), Crimson Forest (after Iron Fever, chain-sickle gap), Meigu Lake east (Midlake Long Pillar Dock, boat), Meigu Lake west (Discordance realm, Dread Axe), and the fifth past the Green Serpent House near the Covered Corridor bell (right path, chain-sickle down to a hidden platform) — that one must be done before the Mount Soulrend finale. Save 2026-11-08 16:48: tasks 11011 with Tutorial_Longzhu1-4 all done, so the open task is the Covered Corridor pillar.

hintStarted.tr: Beşinci Lóng Sütunu Yeşil Yılan Evi geçidinden sonra, Kapalı Koridor çanından sağdaki yolda: aşağıdaki kanca noktasına zincir orakla in, gizli platform batı yakadaki sütuna çıkar. Ruhyaran Dağı'ndaki final dizisinden önce bitir; ilk dört sütun sonradan da yapılabilir.
hintStarted.en: The fifth Lóng Pillar is past the Green Serpent House gate, on the right path from the Covered Corridor bell: use the chain sickle on the grapple point below, the hidden platform leads to the west-side pillar. Finish it before the Mount Soulrend finale; the first four pillars can be done later.

names.en: Crimson Forest: last petal of the first memory flower

hintNotStarted.tr: Bu bölgedeki küçük koruluğun sonundaki anı yaprağını al; sonra oraya dönülemiyor.

hintNotStarted.en: A healer in this area needs herbs; accept the task before gathering them.

missables.note: Accept before gathering the herbs; gathering first may leave the quest unobtainable (single comment, unverified). Region: weeping-creek-valley (the quest is visible with XiGu); the cutoff boss may be met from the Crimson Forest too (exactWhen).

warn.tr: Yakındaki cesedi hemen incele; önce kaydedersen görev kilitlenebilir.
warn.en: Inspect the nearby body right away; saving first can lock the quest.

Lanlan being found dead is not a failure (single source). Still bugged after patch 1.0302256. Real-save check 2026-11-07 02:25: Wu Lengshuang = BP_Monster_WuLengShuang (killed, 2 attempts); right after the fight the player inspected the body without a bell, and BaiShanMiWen went 1:Activating → 1:Completed 2:Completed 3:Activating. doneWhen = branch 2 Completed (the body step); branch 3 = Yubi. The cutoff stays undetectable (a save after the kill without branch 2 would suggest the lock, but no failure is asserted).

warn.tr: Bu görevin bir parçası bir boss dövüşüne bağlı; o dövüşü atlama.
warn.en: One piece of this quest depends on a boss fight; do not skip that fight.

warnNamed.tr: Hayali Pipa: arka plaka Yubi dövüşünden sonra gelir; Baishan görevi kilitlenirse Yubi → Pipa → gerçek son zinciri kopabilir.
warnNamed.en: Illusory Pipa: the back plate comes after the Yubi fight; if the Baishan quest locks, the Yubi → Pipa → true ending chain can break.

missables.note: Region: mandate-encampment (the Yubi fight); a guess, the rule has no activeWhen so it never reaches the default view.
Mirage Estate Opera House: take the Quick Hand treasure (Gold-and-Silver Sachet) on the first visit; it may close later (single player + CN guide).

warn.tr: Bu malikânenin sonunda bir duvardan son bölgeye geçilir; bir kaynağa göre sonra diğer bölgelere dönülemez. Geçmeden önce başka bölgelerde kalan işleri bitir.
warn.en: At the end of this estate a wall leads to the final region; one source says you cannot return to the other regions afterwards. Finish work left in other regions before crossing.

warnNamed.tr: Yas Salonu (Mourning Hall) çanı yakınındaki duvar → Ruhyaran Dağı: PowerPyx'e göre geçince diğer bölgelere dönüş kapanır (Steam raporları asıl son noktanın Ezici ve Testere sonrası "Last Chance" çanı olduğunu söylüyor; güvenli tarafta kal). Geçmeden önce: Çabuk El'in göl hazineleri ve Serap Malikânesi hazineleri, teslim Zhang'ın Serap sığınağında (Gök Gürültüsü Ay Feneri; başka sığınakta teslim fenerin kaçmasına yol açabilir); Kızıl Orman'da yeni açılan donmuş Aynalı Koru: Üçlü Tehdit (3 çiçek Serap'ta, sonra Yucong, Alevli Keskin ile), Kopmuş Zihin Mührü'nün son taşı (donmuş kule), Yumruğun Kalbi (Sha-Chi Kulesi 6. kat Demir İblis); Kefaret Defteri (Hapis Dağı); 5. Lóng Sütunu (Kapalı Koridor çanı); Nuo Maskesi parçaları Keder/Öfke/Neşe → Nuo Maske Sunağı'ndaki Yaşlı Dilenci. Kaplan Topu (Lei Dang) sonrası çıkmayan anı çiçeği Ruhyaran ziyaretinden sonra çıkabiliyor.
warnNamed.en: The wall near the Mourning Hall bell → Mount Soulrend: PowerPyx says you cannot return to the other regions after it (Steam reports put the real point of no return at the "Last Chance" bell after the Crusher and the Saw; stay on the safe side). Before crossing: Quick Hand's lake and Mirage Estate treasures, handed in at Zhang's Mirage Estate hideout (Thundermoon Lantern; handing in elsewhere may lose the lantern); the newly opened frozen Mirrorwood in Crimson Forest: Triple Threat (3 flowers in the estate, then Yucong with the Blazing Edge), the last Severed Mindseal stone (frozen tower), Heart of the Fist (Iron Fiend, Sha-Chi Tower 6th floor); Ledger of Atonement (Mountain of Imprisonment); the 5th Lóng Pillar (Covered Corridor bell); Nuo Mask pieces Sorrow/Wrath/Joy → the Old Beggar at the Nuo Mask Altar. A memory flower that does not appear after the Tiger Cannon (Lei Dang) may show up after visiting Mount Soulrend.

missables.note: PowerPyx Mirage Estate walkthrough: "Going to the next region through the wall near the Morning Hall Bell will make it so you cannot return to other regions in the game." Conflicts with the Steam reports behind the final cutoff (Last Chance bell after Crusher & Saw, Mountain of Imprisonment stays open). Kept as an info rule on the estate until a save shows what the wall does; Bell_XM_015 (named "Mirage Estate", on the Pangzhen map) is excluded. Map code of the estate still unknown (not in RecentlyInteractedAtByMap as of 2026-11-08 17:26).

hintNotStarted.tr: Asansörden önce arenanın yakınındaki kılıcı al; sonra dönülemiyor.

missables.note: Wild Oriole Sword (乱莺剑), save code LuanYing (Inventory.MainWeaponInfos). Verified by timing on a real save: picked up on the pier after Mu Xiaokui. Not picked up when the lift cutoff is passed → missed.

hintNotStarted.tr: Bu vadide bulduğun işaretli taşı, vadiden çıkmadan önce sahibine teslim et.
hintNotStarted.en: Hand the marked stone you find in this valley to its keeper before leaving the valley.

missables.note: Deliver the Weeping Creek Valley stone to the Shadow Warden before leaving; the last stone is in the frozen Crimson Forest tower after Mirage Estate. doneWhen (branch 1-1) is a guess.

Cui (XiaoCui): starts above Yuzan's arena in the Village of Lu; Mountain of Imprisonment steps: cage talk → Bi Feng → Rootless Dew → rear door at Commander's Platform → second rescue after Kui Yanyan (give dew) → Lu Sanqian before the shrine boss gives Crude Radiant Heart → parents on Mount Soulrend before the Crusher and the Saw → Lu Jieyuan after that fight gives Baishan Ribbon. Sources: gamingdeputy FR, playnews, keengamer (Bi Feng itself has no missable).

Komutan Platformu'ndaki arka kapıyı aç ve Lu Sanqian'la konuş; Kui Yanyan sonrası asılı kafes odasında kafesini indirip çiyi ver; Ezici ve Testere'den önce Ruhyaran Dağı'ndaki anne-babaya kurdele ve mektubu götür.
hintStarted.en: Take the Rootless Dew before leaving Bi Feng's arena (rocks past the red pavilion). Open the rear door at Commander's Platform and talk to Lu Sanqian; after Kui Yanyan lower his cage in the hanging-cage room and give him the dew; bring the ribbon and letter to Cui's parents on Mount Soulrend before the Crusher and the Saw.

Starts at the Pangzhen inn rooftop (Yuling murmuring about Senior Brother Zhou); the letter (Reading R_12017) is on a body in Mountain of Imprisonment NE of Kui Yanyan / Shrine Outer Gate (keengamer; pickup place on the real save not verified). Seen Started 2026-11-07 22:51. Cutoff final (ordinary tale, no earlier lock known).

hintStarted.en: Hand Zhou Ping's last letter to Yuling on the upper floor of the building east of the Pangzhen Marketplace bell (the entrance opens with the Illusory Pipa).

names.en: Memory Flower of the Mandate Leaders

missables.note: Quest BuMieXiaDan (The Undying Heroic Spirit) seen in a save 2026-11-06: status now follows the save. Six petals from allied NPCs who ask to be killed after their fight (first one in Pangzhen before the well; most at the Mandate Encampment, a few in later Pangzhen). Kill them while they kneel / before they transform (~10 s); after the transformation no petal drops. 4/6 needed for the quest (The Undying Heroic Spirit, reading item at Myst's tavern), all 6 for the HP bonus. Confirmed by 6 players in a Steam thread of 2026-11-06 and allthings.how; the PT-BR guide's "do not kill" is the outlier. Region: visible from Pangzhen (Bell_SZ_*) and the encampment bells (Bell_YXZR_* except 018, Bell_ZDDY_*). Real-save check 2026-11-07 03:36: Shattered Hero's Courage = I_06006 (data/items.json); from then on BuMieXiaDan branch 1 TasksProgress is the petal counter (1/6 at that save).

warn.tr: Bu kasabadan itibaren: dövüş sonrası diz çöküp "beni öldür" diyen dost bir savaşçıyı hemen öldür; dönüşürse anı çiçeği yaprağı düşmez. Güçlü silahla gir. Yere düşen mavi çiçek o an toplanamaz; görevin bir sonraki bölgedeki adımından sonra geri dönüp alırsın.
warn.en: From this town on: when a friendly fighter kneels after a fight and asks to be killed, kill him at once; if he transforms, no memory-flower petal drops. Use a strong weapon. The blue flower it leaves cannot be picked up yet; you come back for it after a quest step in the next area.

warnNamed.tr: Ölmez Kahramanlık Ruhu: diz çöken ferman liderlerini dönüşmeden (~10 sn) öldür, yoksa yaprak düşmez; önce etraftaki küçük düşmanları temizle. Pangzhen'de 2 tane (Pond of Fading Song çanı yakını, Flaming Mane ister; Slums çanından merdiven aşağı), Ferman Ordugâhı'nda 4. Görev için 4/6, HP bonusu için 6/6. Düşen çiçek Shattered Hero's Courage alınmadan toplanamaz (Ordugâh'taki Chief Disciple sonrası Pangzhen'deki mor cüppeliye dön); çiçek yerde kalır.
warnNamed.en: The Undying Heroic Spirit: kill the kneeling Mandate leaders before they transform (~10 s) or no petal drops; clear the small enemies around them first. 2 in Pangzhen (near the Pond of Fading Song bell, needs the Flaming Mane; down the stairs from the Slums bell), 4 at the Mandate Encampment. 4/6 for the quest, 6/6 for the HP bonus. The dropped flower cannot be collected until you hold the Shattered Hero's Courage (after the Chief Disciple at the encampment, return to the purple-robed man in Pangzhen); it stays on the ground.

missables.note: Companion of mandate-leaders-flower (detect:false): the actionable warning in the default view. Steam thread 2026-11-06 (6 players agree); allthings.how: ~10 s kneel, three failed releases fail the quest. 17173 (2026-11-03): 2 in Pangzhen (Pond of Fading Song area after the Flaming Mane; Slums bell, down the stairs), 4 at the Mandate Encampment; light-blue HP bar. PowerPyx comments (2026-10-30/31): the dropped flower only shows a text prompt until the Shattered Hero's Courage is obtained; then it can be collected (player confirmed). Region: pangzhen + mandate-encampment (first = primary); grouped under whichever the player is in.

warn.tr: Bu kasabanın hanından bir ev anahtarı alıp o evin üst kat yatak odasındaki anı çiçeğini almadan göle açılma; göldeki iskele boss'unu önce öldürürsen bir görev kilitleniyor.

warnNamed.tr: Yeniden Kardeş (A Brother Once More): Myst'in Hanı'nda Niu'dan Huang konağı anahtarını al, Huang konağı önündeki kavşak çanından konağın 2. kat yatak odasındaki anı çiçeğini al (görev başlar). Meigu Gölü'ndeki Lu köyü sığlığı iskelesinde Jin'i bundan önce öldürürsen görev kilitleniyor (Steam, 2 oyuncu).
warnNamed.en: A Brother Once More: take the Huang residence key from Niu at Myst's Tavern, then pick up the memory flower in the residence's upstairs bedroom (quest starts). Killing Jin at the Lu village shallows dock on Meigu Lake before that locks the quest (Steam, 2 players).

missables.note: Quest id ZaiHuiXiongZhang (QuestRumor_010) seen in a save 2026-11-06; the warning stops once the quest is in the save. Trigger per GamerSky; lockout per one Steam thread (OP + one "same here"), so guess:true.

warn.en: In the next mountain area, if a masked man asks you to find his lost ledger: when you bring it back, do not let him go; confront him (fight). Letting him go makes him kill the puppet behind him, costing a quest and an accessory (disputed, stay on the safe side).

warnNamed.tr: Kefaret Defteri (Hapis Dağı, Chen Zhu): sonunda "This won't absolve you of your sins" seç. "Leave him be" dersen Game8/PowerPyx'e göre Bai Xue görevi, Snow and Blood aksesuarı ve 2 anı çiçeği kaçıyor; allthings.how kaçmaz diyor.
warnNamed.en: Ledger of Atonement (Mountain of Imprisonment, Chen Zhu): pick "This won't absolve you of your sins". Per Game8/PowerPyx, "Leave him be" loses the Bai Xue tale, the Snow and Blood accessory and 2 memory flowers; allthings.how says it does not.

missables.note: Disputed: Game8 (2026-11-05) and PowerPyx say the peaceful option kills the female puppet and locks Bai Xue; allthings.how (2026-11-01) says both paths keep Bai Xue. Fight is safe in every source. warn.en: Collect the related flowers before this quest's final fight.

Alevli Kılıç ayrı bir silah değil: Pangzhen'deki Myst'te Sanguine Erişim'e Ruh Tavlaması (Söndürülmüş Alevli Kabza + Kavurucu Alev parçaları + 5000 Kalıntı Tozu). Yucong'dan sonra görev Ağlayan Dere Vadisi'ne, Hanımın heykelindeki Yarık'a dönüyor; ödül Donduran Kaos.
warnNamed.en: Triple Threat: the three Three-Faced Chaos flowers are in Mirage Estate; the final fight is in the frozen Mirrorwood in Crimson Forest and needs the Blazing Edge. The Blazing Edge is not a separate weapon: Soul Temper Sanguine Reach at Myst in Pangzhen (Quenched Flaming Grip + Scorching Flame fragments + 5000 Remnant Dust). After Yucong the quest returns to Weeping Creek Valley, the Rift inside the Lady's statue; reward Freezing Chaos.

missables.note: Details (spoilers): the 3 Three-Faced Chaos flowers are in Mirage Estate; Yucong's third phase is triggered with the Blazing Edge (CN guide). Quest tasks (QuestMazeDes_017): S2 Mirrorwood entrance, S3 flowers in Mirage Estate, S4 "equip the Soul-Tempered Sanguine Reach", S5 deeper into the Mirrorwood, 1 "use the Blazing Edge to defeat the Three-Faced Puppet that fled to the Mirrorwood", S7 "return to Weeping Creek Valley, the Rift inside the Lady's statue". Blazing Edge = Soul Tempered Sanguine Reach (WeaponDes_UI_014; Gfinity). Save 2026-11-08 21:35: S1-S3,S5 Completed, S6 + branch 1 Activating at Bell_FJZL_GP_002 (unnamed).

hintStarted.tr: Ayna Korusu'na girmeden önce Pangzhen'de Myst'e uğrayıp Sanguine Erişim'i Ruh Tavlaması ile Alevli Kılıç yap; Yucong'un son aşaması onsuz tetiklenmiyor. Sonra Ağlayan Dere Vadisi'nde Hanımın heykelindeki Yarık.
hintStarted.en: Before going deep into the Mirrorwood, Soul Temper Sanguine Reach into the Blazing Edge at Myst in Pangzhen; Yucong's last phase does not trigger without it. Then the Rift inside the Lady's statue in Weeping Creek Valley.

warnNamed.en: Leave None Alive (Village of Lu): when the monk asks 'Do you believe in the Lady of the Veil?', answer 'I don't believe', then bring Huijue's Remains to the Stately Monk. Answering 'I believe' turns the monk to stone and the Agarwood Prayer Beads are lost for good.

warn.tr: Baishan Tarikatının Sırları: bu görevde bir konuşmada iki seçenek sunulursa suçlayan cevabı seç; diğeri bir aksesuarı kaçırabilir (kaynaklar tartışmalı).
warn.en: Secrets of the Baishan Sect: if a conversation in this quest offers two answers, pick the accusing one; the other may lose an accessory (sources disagree).

warnNamed.tr: Baishan Tarikatının Sırları (Kızıl Orman, Thieves' Camp yakınındaki köprü): Ju ile konuşmada "It was you who killed her!" diye suçla, sonra Ju'yu yen; "Mourn, and let go" seçeneği Seal of Dugu'yu kaçırabilir (bir kaynak yalnız dövüşü erteler diyor).

missables.note: Disputed: criticalhits/xboxplay say mourning loses the Seal of Dugu for good; allthings says it only delays the fight until the Ambush Forest step. warn.tr: Bu köyde saklanan yaşlı bir adam yardım isterse iki soruda da kabul et; reddedersen sonra kaçan bir görev zinciri olabilir.
warn.en: If an old man hiding in this village asks for help, agree both times; refusing can cost a quest chain later.

warnNamed.tr: Eve Yolculuk (Lu Köyü, Old Man Gen'in sığınağı): iki soruda da kabul et (Brass Key). Görev ilk adımındayken Pangzhen arka sokağına gidersen War Wagon Phantom Edge, Gen'in anı çiçeği ve Together Till the End başarımı kaçar.
warnNamed.en: The Journey Home (Village of Lu, Old Man Gen's hideout): agree both times (Brass Key). Reaching the Pangzhen backstreet while the quest is on its first step loses the War Wagon Phantom Edge, Gen's memory flower and the Together Till the End achievement.

warn.tr: Bu köyde, tünel girişindeki çanın yanındaki kapının dibinde yaralı bir adam varsa elindeki kitabı ona ver; bölgede ilerleyince ölüyor.
warn.en: In this village, if a wounded man lies by the door next to the bell at the tunnel entrance, give him the book you carry; he dies as you progress through the area.

warnNamed.tr: Yaralı Hırsız (Lu Köyü, Smuggler's Tunnel girişindeki çanın yanındaki kapı): Thief's Manual'ı ona ver → Arrowward (aksesuar). Bölgede fazla ilerleyince ölüyor; tetikleyicisi bilinmiyor, erken ver.
warnNamed.en: Wounded Thief (Village of Lu, by the door next to the Smuggler's Tunnel entrance bell): give him the Thief's Manual → Arrowward (accessory). He dies once you progress far enough into the area; the trigger is unknown, so do it early.

missables.note: PowerPyx Village of Lu #41 Arrowward, marked missable: he dies when progressing too far into the region, trigger unknown. Unverified: the exact spot (door next to the Smuggler's Tunnel entrance bell) comes from the hand-over, not from the PowerPyx text; activeWhen ends with the village chapter quest (MainCh1-ShiXinCun) done, a guess (he may die earlier). doneWhen: Arrowward = AC_ResistRanged (Inventory.AccessoryInfos), verified by timing on a real save; once it is in the save the warning leaves the default view.

names.tr: Çabuk El'in İsteği'ni başlat: Kızıl Orman'ın üç hazinesini Thieves' Camp yanındaki sığınakta Quick Hand Zhang'a teslim et (mor görev, gerçek son)
names.en: Start Quick Hand's Request: hand the three Crimson Forest treasures to Quick Hand Zhang at the hideout next to the Thieves' Camp (purple quest, true ending)

hintNotStarted.tr: Bir hazine avcısı için topladığın üç eşyayı, ilk tanıştığın bölgedeki sığınağına teslim et; bu, gerçek sona bağlı bir görevi başlatıyor.
hintNotStarted.en: Hand the three items you collected for a treasure hunter to his hideout in the area where you first met him; this starts a quest tied to the true ending.

missables.note: Quick Hand's Request (QuestCollect_003, purple, true ending; pinyin unknown, so no questSeen) starts by delivering the Crimson Forest treasures (InventoryInfos T_02001-T_02003) to Quick Hand Zhang at his hideout next to the Thieves' Camp (QuestCollectDes_003_02), then the Village of Lu, Pangzhen, Meigu Lake and Mirage Estate treasures. Seen on a real save: all three Crimson Forest treasures held, The Wily Hare's Three Dens (JiaoTuSanKu) branch 1 ('find Zhang's hidden treasure') still Activating, Quick Hand's Request not started, and Zhang not at the Village of Lu hideout. Guesses: doneWhen (JiaoTuSanKu branch 1 Completed = treasures delivered), that the chain is sequential, and the cutoff (mirage: the Crimson Forest is overwritten by snow after Mirage Estate). activeWhen: only while the three treasures are held and not yet delivered.

warn.tr: Bu köyde bulduğun üç hazineyi, güvenli tarafta kalmak için asansörden önce hazine meraklısının saklandığı yere götür.
warn.en: To be safe, bring the three treasures you find in this village to the treasure lover's hiding place before taking the lift.

warnNamed.tr: Quick Hand Zhang'ın üç hazinesi (Lu Köyü): Düğün Mumları (Wedding Candles), Açığa Çıkan Heykel (Unveiled Statue) ve Beyaz Yeşim İkizler (White Jade Twins). Üçünü Zhang's Hideout çanında Quick Hand Zhang'a götür → Fine Thread. Asansörden önce yap (son tarih doğrulanmadı).
warnNamed.en: Quick Hand Zhang's three treasures (Village of Lu): Wedding Candles, Unveiled Statue and White Jade Twins. Bring all three to Quick Hand Zhang at the Zhang's Hideout bell → Fine Thread. Do it before the lift (the deadline is not verified).

missables.note: PowerPyx Village of Lu #58 Fine Thread (treasures #23, #36, #57). PowerPyx gives no deadline and does not mark it missable. Unverified: the 'before the lift' cutoff (activeWhen ends with MainCh1-ShiXinCun done, the same stand-in as the lu-elevator cutoff's passedWhen) and whether the hand-in can be missed at all. Likely depends on Quick Hand's Request having started (rule quickhand-request-start): Zhang may not appear at the Village of Lu hideout until the Crimson Forest treasures are delivered at his Crimson Forest hideout (sequential chain; guess). Patch name of Unveiled Statue: Peçesiz Heykel (Item_Treasure_LJC_003). Verified 2026-11-06: the Village of Lu hand-in completes MiaoShouKongKong branch 3 (and 3-1); T_05001..3 drop to 0; Fine Thread is probably AC_Control (acquired 03:46).

warn.tr: Bu köyde biri bir tüneli temizlemek için yardım isterse 'ilgileniyorum' de; reddedersen görev hiç başlamaz.
warn.en: If someone in this village asks for help clearing a tunnel, say you're interested; refusing means the quest never starts.

warnNamed.tr: Genç Efendi Lan (Lu Köyü): Smuggler's Tunnel sorusuna 'Interested' de ve ilk adımı Pangzhen'den önce bitir; 'Not Interested' Lan Manor Key, Crimson Resolve ve A Wanderer's Honor başarımını kaçırır. Not: bir kaynağa göre bu görevde Lan ölüyor.
warnNamed.en: Young Master Lan (Village of Lu): answer 'Interested' to the Smuggler's Tunnel question and finish the first step before Pangzhen; 'Not Interested' loses the Lan Manor Key, Crimson Resolve and the A Wanderer's Honor achievement. Note: one source says Lan dies in this quest.

missables.note: The start choice is from Game8 only; the achievement and the Pangzhen cutoff are confirmed by PowerPyx and KeenGamer.

warn.tr: Bu kasabada bir köprüde biri seni uyarırsa ve göl görevin bitmediyse 'sonra dön' de.
warn.en: If someone warns you at a bridge in this town and your lake quest isn't finished, choose to come back later.

warnNamed.tr: Mirage Estate köprüsü (Pangzhen arka sokağı, Inanis'in uyarısı): Gölün Kalbindeki Sırlar bitmediyse "Return later" de; geçersen Kızıl Orman'daki bazı çanlar kapanır, Ağlayış Nereden Gelir'in iki adımı engellenir ve göl görevi yarım kalırsa gerçek olmayan son gelir.
warnNamed.en: Mirage Estate bridge (Pangzhen backstreet, Inanis's warning): if Secrets at the Heart of the Lake is unfinished, choose "Return later"; crossing disables some Crimson Forest bells, blocks two Whence the Weeping steps, and an unfinished lake quest leads to the non-true ending.

warn.tr: Vadideki genç şifacı nadir bir çiçeği isterse ona ver; karşılığında verdiği şey sonraki bir görevin iyi sonu için gerekiyor.
warn.en: If the young healer in the valley asks for a rare flower, give it to her; what she gives back is needed for a later good outcome.

warnNamed.tr: Et Zambağı (Ağlayan Dere Vadisi): Flesh Lily'yi Yu'er'e ver, "gerçek" ikiz çiçeği geri verir. Onsuz Pangzhen'deki The Heart's Trail'de babası ölür ve Blessed Jade Pendant yerine Tarnished Jade Pendant alırsın. Teslim, Bai Chilian'dan önce yapılmalı.
warnNamed.en: Flesh Lily (Weeping Creek Valley): give the Flesh Lily to Yu'er; she gives back the twin "real" one. Without it her father dies in The Heart's Trail (Pangzhen) and you get the Tarnished instead of the Blessed Jade Pendant. Hand it in before Bai Chilian.

missables.note: Give option from Game8; the pendant outcome from allthings only (its pages partly contradict each other).

warn.tr: Bu ormanda kafese kapatılmış biri kaçmak için yardım isterse kabul et; reddetmek bir dükkânı ve iki görev zincirini kaçırabilir.
warn.en: If someone caged in this forest asks for help escaping, agree; refusing may cost a shop and two quest chains.

warnNamed.tr: Kurnaz Tavşanın Üç İni (Kızıl Orman, Trail of Cages): Quick Hand Zhang'ın kaçmasına yardım et; 'Leave' Quick Hand Pendant'ı, dükkânını ve iki görev zincirini kaçırabilir (sonradan dönülebilir mi bilinmiyor).
warnNamed.en: The Wily Hare's Three Dens (Crimson Forest, Trail of Cages): help Quick Hand Zhang escape; 'Leave' may lose the Quick Hand Pendant, his shop and both questlines (unknown whether you can come back).

warn.tr: Kafesteki bir yaşlıyı ikinci kez kurtarırken bir dövüş alanında bulduğun çiyi ona ver.
warn.en: When freeing a caged old man a second time, give him the dew found in a fight arena.

warnNamed.tr: Lu Sanqian / Cui (Mountain of Imprisonment): ikinci kafesten kurtarırken Rootless Dew'i ver (Bi Feng arenasındaki kırmızı köşk); vermezsen The Lady's Shrine'a ulaşmaz ve Crude Radiant Heart kaçar.
warnNamed.en: Lu Sanqian / Cui (Mountain of Imprisonment): give the Rootless Dew when freeing him from the second cage (red gazebo in Bi Feng's arena); otherwise he never reaches The Lady's Shrine and the Crude Radiant Heart is lost.

missables.note: Cui quest = XiaoCui (QuestRumor_018). Rootless Dew (Other_All_Item_valuables_001 "Köksüz Çiy") lies on the rocks beyond the big red pavilion in Bi Feng's arena (Cavern Passage); give it to Lu Sanqian at the second rescue (hanging-cage room below Shrine Outer Gate, after Kui Yanyan). Without it he never reaches The Lady's Shrine and Crude Radiant Heart is lost (gamingdeputy FR walkthrough; playnews). Save code of the dew unknown, so detect stays off. Triggers added 2026-11-08 once the DDSD prefix was known. doneWhen: XiaoCui branch 4-A reached (Activating or Completed). On the real save (2026-11-08 04:14:28) branch 3 completed and 4-A activated at the same second right after the second rescue in the hanging-cage room, and Yusuf reported giving the dew; 4-B stayed None. Reading: 4-A = "Lu Sanqian drank the Rootless Dew" (QuestDes_01-DDSD_012), 4-B = "his days are numbered" (DDSD_013, dew not given). Branch meaning inferred from one save, not from the quest asset.

trueEnding._comment: Gerçek son şartı olan mor görevler (günlükte 'Hikâye' sekmesi, mor ikon). Klasöre göre değil, bu listeye göre sayılır: Branch klasöründe mor olmayanlar da var (XueRouHua, SanMianHunDun 'Öyküler' sekmesinde). Kaynak: gerçek son rehberleri (Game8, Maxroll, PowerPyx). quest=null: pinyin kodu bilinmiyor; kayıtta tanınamadığı için hiç gösterilmez.

quests.en: Secrets at the Heart of the Lake

trueEnding.note: Some guides (a Steam 100% achievements guide, since removed from the Steam community; a true-ending checklist) also list defeating two optional blade-master bosses as a true-ending requirement. Unverified and not tracked yet; verify from the save when those areas are reached.
trueEnding.claim: Unverified claim (single Steam guide, Nero): the two blade masters (Zhu Yuan, Bi Feng) are required for the true ending. PowerPyx does not say so; the CN guide lists them only under an achievement. Not tracked.
